title: Lien-Process Fees in a Storage Unit Catch-Up Draft: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Billing Note
content:
For a storage unit authorization under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the unit catch-up amount adds the lien-process fees of the delinquency: **the overlock fee plus the lien notice fee** where a lien notice fee is posted against the returned due date; **the overlock fee alone** where only an overlock fee is posted against it; and **nothing** otherwise.

Posted against the returned due date means a fee entry on the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement ledger, of type lien notice fee or overlock fee, whose period is the returned due date (the agreement's oldest unpaid due date). The fees added are the unit class figures:

| Unit class | Overlock fee | Lien notice fee | Both together |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $25.00 | $45.00 | $70.00 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $25.00 | $45.00 | $70.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $25.00 | $45.00 | $70.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $25.00 | $45.00 | $70.00 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $30.00 | $55.00 | $85.00 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $30.00 | $55.00 | $85.00 |

| Lien notice fee posted against the returned due date | Overlock fee posted against it | Added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or No | Overlock fee plus lien notice fee |
| No | Yes | Overlock fee |
| No | No | Nothing |

*Hypothetical, Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault:* a lien notice fee posted for the returned due date adds $85.00; only an overlock fee adds $30.00; an overlock fee posted for a later period adds nothing.
